content: In this work, we define a novel generative approach to leverage continuous word representations for unsupervised learning of syntactic structure. Experiments on both POS induction and unsupervised dependency parsing tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach. Future work might explore more sophisticated invertible projections, or recurrent projections that jointly transform the entire input sequence.
